greeting: Welcome back to solid ground, Dan. The Croatia charter is behind you and you touch down in Tampa by late afternoon; the girls aren't back until Tuesday, so tonight is for landing, not doing.

needsAttention.title: Reply to the Brunswick recruiter intro
needsAttention.detail: Lauren connected you with Erika, who leads senior recruitment at Brunswick and already has your resume; she left it to the two of you to find a time, so a note back to set one up is the move. This is a warm job-search thread, not a cold one.

needsAttention.title: Rental car waiting at Tampa
needsAttention.detail: Your travel list flags the Sept 20-Oct 5 full-size SUV as book-it-outright and it is weeks overdue. You just landed at TPA and shouldn't be facing walk-up rates jet-lagged on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Where you sleep tonight and tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-22 St Pete gap is still open on your travel list, overdue since Aug 25. The kids aren't picked up until Tuesday, so you need a bed for tonight and tomorrow before the Orlando villa starts.
